config.purpose: Out-of-asset replication of btc_multifactor_v1 on XRP options: Double Heston vs Single Heston vs Black-Scholes (per expiry), every model calibrated per date, scored on held-out options. Rules fixed before any XRP option data is fetched or any model fitted.
config.convention: Deribit quotes XRP_USDC option prices in USDC as the undiscounted Black-76 price (checked on one trade before freezing: 0.014498 model vs 0.0145 traded). The forward-normalised call is c = price/F for calls, and c = price/F + 1 - K/F for puts.
config.forward: Per trade, solve for F from (price, trade iv, K, tau) under the convention. Per expiry, take the median of F/index over the day's trades. Each quote's forward is that ratio times the index at its own trade time.
config.window_reason: XRP options trade far less than BTC, so a full UTC day is used instead of 2 hours; last trade per instrument.
config.quote: Last trade per instrument in the window. Primary target: trade price. Secondary robustness target: the exchange mark price at that trade.

date_rule.definition: RV10 = annualised (sqrt 365) std of the last 10 daily log returns of the perpetual close. ratio = RV10 / median(RV10 over the previous 60 days). Shock onset: ratio >= 1.5, de-duplicated over 20 days; surfaces 1, 4 and 8 days after onset. Calm: |ratio - 1| <= 0.1, max/min RV10 over the last 21 days <= its own 25th percentile over all eligible days (amendment 01, pre-fetch: the fixed 1.3 admitted 1 of 899 days because RV10 is far noisier than DVOL), more than 20 days from any shock onset; 25 drawn by seed, surface the next day.
date_rule.why_not_implied: Deribit publishes no XRP volatility index; realised volatility from spot is used so dates stay model-free and option-free.
date_rule.split: No validation stage: every selected date is a test date (see variants).
date_rule.unavailable_dates: disclosed; never replaced by other dates

designs.B_heldout_expiries: PRIMARY. Sort a date's expiries by maturity; hold out every odd-ranked expiry except the longest. Calibrate on the rest; score all quotes of held-out expiries.
designs.A_heldout_strikes: SECONDARY. Within each expiry, sort by strike; hold out odd-ranked strikes.

models.BS_EXPIRY: One Black-76 volatility per calibration expiry (grouped by the expiry column, per btc AMENDMENT_01). Other expiries: linear total-variance interpolation between expiry knots, flat outside.
models.SH: Heston, all five parameters calibrated per date and design; feller_free.
models.DH: Double Heston, separable four-shock literature_exact convention, slow-first ordering, all ten parameters calibrated per date and design; feller_free.

config.variants: Fixed in advance to feller_free for both SH and DH, inherited from the BTC validation choice (btc_multifactor_v1/artifacts/variant_selection.json). No XRP date is used for any choice.
config.bounds_note: Identical to BTC so this is a clean replication; the binding vol-of-vol bound is reported, not changed.
config.objective: Mean squared vega-weighted price residual, identical to BTC.
config.primary_endpoint: Shock dates, design B. Per episode, average the per-date paired differences in held-out IV RMSE (SH - DH, BS_EXPIRY - DH). DH beats a competitor only if the one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over episodes gives p < 0.05 AND the episode-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of the mean difference is > 0 (5,000 replicates, seed 20260920).
integrity: Dates come from spot realised volatility alone before any XRP option data is fetched.
No filter, split, metric, bound, optimizer setting or endpoint changes after fits are seen.
Failed dates, fits and fallbacks are retained and disclosed.
Trade prices are not synchronized bid/ask; no spread-based claims.

Pre-freeze contact with XRP option data: one trade, used only to confirm the price convention, and daily counts on eleven dates to find when history begins, and the list of currently listed XRP expiries (6).
